Application readiness, final click, and post-submission proof share the exact-form Send resolver. Post-submission proof rejects ambiguous forms, multiple eligible controls, and a still-enabled eligible control.

Synthetic regression cases cover both Send shapes, union identity, unrelated and outside-form buttons, disabled controls, ambiguous controls, and absent or multiple enclosing forms across readiness, click, and proof gates.

Normal ATTEMPTING handling remains ATTEMPT_REQUIRES_HUMAN without retry. The conformance document binds Human-only recovery exclusively to workflow 36973913060 attempt 1 and requires all specified pre-cleanup proofs while denying reuse for other attempts.
The committed candidate changes only the three permitted files and introduces no workflow, lifecycle-owner, browser-supervisor, deferred-retry, multi-project-lane, or roadmap-advancement behavior.
